name: PayProof
code_name: gouji (the package and repository name; Chinese for cross-checking accounts)
tagline: A pre-payment investigator: before an invoice is paid, it proves who the supplier is, with evidence a program re-reads, and a mandate outside the model decides whether money moves.
track: Track 2: The Agent That Can Explain Why

entry_points.cli: python run.py case INV-5567 | python run.py eval [--data data/heldout] [--live]
entry_points.ui: GET /brief/{inv_id}: the one-page brief, decision first, every finding linked to the cell it cites

sample_mode: SAMPLE_MODE=true, or no keys: no network, scripted planner and reporter, pattern-only Guard, DuckDB backend

zetaris.how: The five systems (ERP, vendor master, contracts, AP mailbox, company registry) stay where they are; each check is one federated SQL query across them, and the Verifier re-reads every cited cell by primary key through the same harness. With ZETARIS_REST_URL and ZETARIS_API_KEY set, all queries go to Zetaris through its REST API; without it, the same SQL runs on DuckDB over the same files.
zetaris.status: REST adapter implemented; not yet run against a live Zetaris instance.

meterless.how: WorldStoreService, IngestPipelineService and ContextBuilderService, implemented from the hackathon guide. Legal entities are keyed by registration number and jurisdiction, never by name, so two companies with the same name are two entities and the doppelganger alert fires. The store is an append-only JSONL log the canonical view rebuilds from. Every model call goes through one injected generator (gouji/llm.py), as the engine guides require.
meterless.bonus: gouji/contract.py: a Scout-style execution contract (HMAC-signed, bound to the exact payment facts, 15-minute expiry, single use). The payment executor refuses to pay without one.

nvidia.how: NVIDIA Nemotron (nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b on build.nvidia.com) wrote the held-out red-team set: impostor e-mails, look-alike domains, new prompt injections, honest text meant to trip a naive filter, and genuine bank-change notices. A different model than the one used while building, so the checks are tested on text their author did not write. Prompts, raw output and SHA-256 hashes are in data/heldout/manifest.json.

cursor.note: Cursor is optional under rule 5.1; this field is updated if the team uses it.

models.planner_reporter_guard: DeepSeek (deepseek-flash) through the injected generator; swappable by configuration

existing_components.name: mandate-engine v0.1.1
existing_components.use: Mandate evaluation (ALLOW / ASK / DENY on clauses), evidence grades and the audit log. Written before the development period (0.1.1 changes only the license, to MIT OR Apache-2.0) and declared as an existing component.

data: Entirely fictional and generated by gouji/world.py (dev set, seed 20261022) and gouji/redteam.py (held-out set, seed 20261024). Domains use the reserved .example suffix; every IBAN carries check digits 00, which ISO 13616 never issues.
limitations: The case mix and volumes are design choices for a fictional buyer, not field data.
The dev set was designed by the same team that wrote the checks; only the held-out set measures generalisation.
